metadata.description: Official Tier Model Active Directory configuration
metadata.author: TierModel Team

comment: Metadata and configuration logic for Tier Model deployment. Contains versioning, conditional logic rules, and deployment framework configuration.

domainTypeDetection.comment: Detect if current domain is forest root by comparing domain DNS name with forest root domain DNS name

groupExistenceCheck.comment: Use Get-ADGroup with error suppression to check if groups exist

adIntegratedDns.comment: DnsAdmins and DnsUpdateProxy groups only exist if AD-Integrated DNS was configured during forest/domain setup

ntService.comment: NT SERVICE accounts are used as literal strings

domainRoot.comment: Resolves to current domain DN for domain-level GPO links

ouPaths.comment: OU paths are constructed by combining relative path with domain DN
